question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**convincing**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about the art of making someone agree with your point of view.
 
• The verb should express the act of influencing or winning agreement.
 
• "**Convincing**" fits perfectly because persuasion literally means convincing someone.
 
• Other options like "**evaluating**", "**motivating**", "**captivating**" do not express the idea of persuading someone to agree.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Evaluating:** means assessing—does not fit the meaning of persuasion.
 
• **Motivating: **means encouraging—related but not accurate for making someone agree.
 
• **Captivating: **means attracting attention—does not express the idea of persuasion.
